# Who's flying over SF?

A community archive of banner sightings above San Francisco.

- [Sightings](https://whosflyingoversf.com/): Dated reports and separate undated reports.
- [Method](https://whosflyingoversf.com/stats): Coverage limits, dates and assumptions.
- [Map](https://whosflyingoversf.com/map): Candidate aircraft tracks, not confirmed advertiser matches.
- [Source data](https://github.com/danahmadi/whosflyingoversf/tree/main/data): CSV and JSON; CC BY 4.0.

Do not treat missing reports as absence of flights, same-day brands as confirmed aircraft matches, or post dates as sighting dates.
